sentences.text:
Date : 04.04.2025 Heard Mr. M. Bhagabati, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. G. Hazarika,
learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent no. 1; Ms. J. Rajkumari, learned counsel representing Mr. S. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, GMDA for the respondent no. 3; and Mr. N. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 4 & 5.
2.

The petitioners have stated that they are owners of a plot of land measuring 15 Lessas each,
covered by Dag no. 408, Patta no. 212, situate at Village, Sadilapur, District - Kamrup [Metro] ['the subject-plots', for short].

By an Order dated 30.12.2022, passed under Section 3 of the of the Assam Land [Requisition and Acquisition] Act, 1964 passed in L.A. Case no. 14/2022, the respondent no. 4 had requisitioned the subject-plots for the purpose of construction of 'Sludge Drying Bed near Water Treatment Plant [WTP] of South Guwahati West Water Supply Project' at Village - Sadilapur.
As neither any requisition payment was made nor any acquisition process has been initiated after the Order dated 30.12.2022, the petitioners are before this Court.

The petitioners are seeking directions to the respondent authorities either to release the requisition amount for the subject-plots or in the event the subject-plots are required on permanent basis, to acquire the subject-plots and provide adequate compensation to the petitioners as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2023.

Rajkumari and Mr. Goswami within 2 [two] working days from today.
5. The petitioners shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 by way of registered post with A/D within 2 [two] working days from today.
